pins.name: VIN
pins.notes: Adafruit-style pin order. Other BNO08x boards differ: check the silkscreen

pins.name: 3VO
pins.notes: Output of the on-board 3.3 V regulator. Leave unconnected

pins.name: INT
pins.notes: LOW when the sensor has data. Recommended

pins.name: CS
pins.notes: SPI chip select. Leave unconnected or HIGH for I2C

pins.name: DI
pins.notes: SPI data in / address select in I2C mode. Leave unconnected for 0x4A

pins.name: P0
pins.notes: Protocol select. Leave LOW for I2C

pins.name: P1
pins.notes: Protocol select. Leave LOW for I2C

sources.title: CEVA / Hillcrest BNO08X datasheet
sources.section: I2C address 0x4A (SA0 LOW) / 0x4B (SA0 HIGH); SHTP protocol, no simple ID register
